text:
rik: Noticing a clusterwide Pending surge in us-central1 after rack-level NVLink health flaps. Scheduler logs show "0/200 nodes available: 140 node(s) had incompatible GPU families, 60 node(s) had topologySpread conflicts".
elaine: which GPU families? A100 vs H100 vs L4?
tim: majority warmpool is H100/large, but recent provisioning filled some racks with L4 (cost-optimized). Strict gpu.family-match is blocking many small-gang jobs.
rik: sample pod describe:
```
Name: bert-train-9
Namespace: nlp
Status: Pending
Message: 0/200 nodes are available: 140 node(s) had incompatible GPU_families, 50 node(s) had topologySpreadConstraint conflicts, 10 node(s) had taints
```
sre-oncall: autoscaler report: [autoscaler] scale up in us-central1: 5 -> 9 nodes due to pending pods.
elaine: short-term remedy options: (1) flip family-match strict->preferred for batch classes, (2) add a placement fallback policy that allows cross-family allocation for low-priority queues, (3) selectively label L4 nodes as `gpu.lowlat=false` so latency-sensitive pods avoid them.
tim: I can push a canary scheduler-config for (1) targeting the nlp namespace only. We'll monitor P99 and billing flavor changes.
rik: can you do a targeted placement-lint to ensure we don't accidentally place tiny-gang on racks without NVLink? We need to avoid breaking multi-gpu jobs.
tim: yes, scheduler can check `nvlink_topology` label; the canary will allow family-preferred but still require `nvlink_topology=full` for gang-scheduled pods.
autoscale-bot: [provisioner] provisioning 4 new nodes in us-central1 (expected ready in 3m).
elaine: action items: tim - create canary and rollback script; rik - run placement-lint and tag unsafe racks; sre-oncall - keep an eye on P99 and eviction rates; I'll draft a short internal note explaining cost/perf tradeoffs.
tim: canary applied at 2805550020. unschedulable_count decreased 380 -> 95 in 4m. P99 for small-gang unchanged so far.
rik: doing placement-lint now, marking 3 racks `nvlink_topology=partial` and adding them to the no-gang zone.
elaine: filed GH infra/placement-789 "fallback scheduling for GPU-family skew + NVLink-aware gang policy". proposal to add skew metric to Console and Optimize recommendations for warmpool composition.
sre-oncall: pending pods down to 12. keeping canary for 20m then evaluate.
tim: will follow up with PR to make family-preferred a configurable per-namespace fallback.
elaine: recommend we add a warm-pool flavor histogram and attach workload tags so Optimize can recommend warmpool mixes per workload to reduce mismatches.
rik: thanks everyone. small cost bump from temporary mixing but mitigated. will post retro notes.
